name: Event 2
definition: Provides information on an event that happened in a system.

EventCode.name: Event Code
EventCode.definition: Proprietary code used to specify an event that occurred in a system.

EventParameter.name: Event Parameter
EventParameter.definition: Describes the parameters of an event which occurred in a system.

EventDescription.name: Event Description
EventDescription.definition: Free text used to describe an event which occurred in a system.

EventTime.name: Event Time
EventTime.definition: Date and time at which the event occurred.
